title: Endava & Flare Boost Cybersecurity with Threat Intelligence | Endava
summary: Endava and Flare partner to enhance cybersecurity with advanced threat intelligence, dark web monitoring, and proactive external risk detection.
body_markdown:
23 April 2026 - London -


[Endava](https://www.endava.com/)


(NYSE ‘DAVA’), the technology-driven business transformation group whose AI-native approach combines cutting edge technology with deep industry expertise, today announced their partner relationship with Flare to help clients strengthen their cybersecurity posture and deliver managed threat intelligence services.


Flare’s Threat Exposure Management (TEM) platform delivers real-time actionable insight that identifies, prioritises and remediates all instances of digital risk. Flare provides context and intelligence to prevent costly breaches and protects organisation’s data, financial assets, and brand reputation.


Together, Endava and Flare enhance organisations’ visibility into cyber threats through advanced dark web monitoring, enriched threat intelligence, and proactive risk detection. By combining Endava’s cyber threat intelligence expertise with Flare’s leading threat intelligence platform, clients can identify, assess and respond to emerging threats faster. Integrating these capabilities into existing CTI workflows delivers more precise insight, empowering security teams to act decisively, protect their brand, and strengthen overall cyber resilience.


Daniel Russell, Cyber Threat Intelligence Lead at Endava said: “The partnership with Flare strengthens our ability to detect and respond to organisational threats before they escalate. By combining Flare’s world-class dark web intelligence with our own outstanding analytical capabilities, we can deliver richer, more actionable insights that genuinely make a difference to our clients’ security posture.”


Andrew Bartlam, VP, Global Channels and EMEA Sales at Flare added: “External threats move quickly, often out of sight. By partnering with Endava, we’re helping organisations bring clarity to that risk surface, so teams can spot what matters, prioritise with confidence and act before issues become incidents. Together, we’re making threat intelligence more practical, timely and usable for the people who rely on it every day.”

About Endava


Endava is a leading provider of next-generation technology services, dedicated to enabling its customers to accelerate growth, tackle complex challenges and thrive in evolving markets. By combining innovative technologies and deep industry expertise with an AI-native approach, Endava consults and partners with customers to create solutions that


drive transformation, augment intelligence and deliver lasting impact. From ideation to production, it supports customers with tailor-made solutions at every stage of their digital transformation, regardless of industry, region or scale.


Endava’s clients span payments, insurance, banking and capital markets, technology, media, telecommunications, healthcare, mobility, retail and consumer goods and more. As of December 31, 2025, 11,385 Endavans are helping clients break new ground across locations in Europe, the Americas, Asia Pacific and the Middle East.


About Flare


Flare is the leader in Threat Exposure Management, helping organizations of all sizes detect high-risk exposures found on the clear and dark web. Combining the industry's best cybercrime database with a ridiculously intuitive user experience, Flare enables customers to reclaim the information advantage and get ahead of threat actors.
